title: Microplane Home Series Multipurpose Coarse Grater - Easy to Use, Perfect for Everyday Cooking (Black)
description:
About this item
BEST FOR - Carrots, Ginger, Nuts, Chocolate, Coconut, and Hard Cheeses. The results will be small gratings.
ULTRA SHARP BLADES - Made in USA! Blades are made of US Stainless Steel, at our facility in Russellville Arkansas; *Support American jobs and manufacturing by purchasing this product.
EASY STORAGE: These paddle-style graters are designed to store flat for your convenience.
SOFT TOUCH HANDLE: The Microplane Home Series family of graters features a soft grip handle for a comfortable grip.
DISHWASHER SAFE: Stainless steel is naturally BPA free. Place the grater in the dishwasher for cleaning.

reviews_5s: Good size, works wellI had one of these until a piece of the plastic rim around the grate surface broke off. This tool has been heavily used and placed in the dishwasher for years. It held up against all odds, so when it broke I bought another just like it. It is used almost dailyCan’t have just 1 kind of microplane and this one is just right. Easy to grip, wash, and store. Consistent grating quality.I already had one. My daughter used it and loved it, so I bought one for her too.Great product!I purchased this to go with my classic microplane grater because it is faster for grating ginger. It works very well and I'm happy with itThis is a must when grating block Parmesan to finish off a nice Italian dish. Well constructed and easy to clean in the dishwasher.An essential tool for finely grating small quantities of hard cheeses, ginger, citrus rind zests and spices like nutmeg. The form is very convenient and easy to use, but the handle will break off with rough treatment. Do not tap to release grated material.There has to be a reason that America's Test Kitchen called this their number one choice. It really does grate things quickly and easily. After spending almost 15 minutes trying to grate enough ginger for a teaspoon and a half with my old grater, I checked around online, found the ATK video and ordered one. I grated some of the same ginger root, making 2 teaspoons, in about a minute and a half. This thing is sharp and gets the job done. Well worth the $19. And it cleans easily and has a plastic cover to keep it clean and sharp while stored. By the way, it is the best tool I've had for making lemon, lime or orange zest.Love this micro plane! Easy to grate anything. The one I used to use was skinny and difficult to handle. This one is great for citrus and garlic and nutmeg. Highly recommend.
reviews_1s:
Paid a premium to get a Microplane. Plastic frame cracked in multiple places in less than 18 months of non-frequent use on just grating medium-hard Parm and Romano cheese. Plastic frame is not at all thick and robust. Money better spent on a better quality brand with a metal frame instead of junk plastic used here.The grater came with an adhesive label on the back of the grater surface. It could not be easily removed and is unusable until a solvent can be found to remove it. I was very disappointed.Poor design compared to their other models. Thankfully, Amazon accepted a return. I replaced this with a "professional" model. I have been happy with their "gourmet" model, which has a superior design.

This model is suitable for hard cheese like parmesan, but is difficult and wasteful to use if grating moist or delicate ingredients like garlic, ginger, and lemon zest. A small spoon or butterknife is required to remove the gratings, and the process is awkward.

The "gourmet" model, like the narrow Microplane graters that made the brand famous, allows the gratings to be slid out of the end of the grater with minimal waste and maximal ease. (My "gourmet" model is still working as good as new, I gave it to my daughter because she liked it.)I was so glad to see someone else wrote a review about the sticker. Why you would take a great product and ruin the customer experience is beyond me. Removing the really large sticker leaves behind tons of residue. I was excited to try it anyway and thought lemon would probably help get the cleaning started so I "wasted" a lemon and was thrilled to find it works great. I threw it in my Bosch that has never let me down and has removed other sticker residue like a champ. When I pulled it out it was basically EXACTLY the same. I've run it through a total of 4 times, scratched it off with my fingernails before one wash and scrubbed it with soap and the abrasive part of a sponge before another. It probably still has 10-15% of the sticker residue still hanging on. No way should someone have to work this hard to use a product and no way should some packaging folks be able to ruin a nicely engineered device. Eventually the satisfaction of use will overcome the irritation - but it is gonna take awhile!I bought this as a replacement for another one that cracked and within 4 months it is cracked againWe replaced our Microplanes that were at least 10 years old due them being worn out- they were no longer sharp enough. These new Microplanes are being used exactly like the old ones and just as frequently. However, the Coarse version of new model lasted only about 4 months before it broke.

edit: Noticed the second one is broken as well. Can't recommenced these at all.... We may try the professional version, but only 1 to see if they hold up.I loved all my old microplane graters. This one came with no cover. I’ve never seen one without the protective cover. I’m going to have to make some kind of cover so I don’t slice a finger reaching into my drawer. Also - a sticker on the metal that was ridiculously difficult to remove. Pretty disappointed.This product deserves nothing but 1 star ratings until they stop placing an obnoxious sticker on the blade.Minimally use to grade garlic or lemon zest only and the handle snapped. Not forcefully used.We had our last one for many years...replaced it because we thought it might not be as sharp as it should be. What a mistake...cheap plastic frame snapped in two places on either side. What a piece of junk!
